p: Caledonian Road, the Cally to locals, is a long, workaday North London road running from King's Cross up towards Holloway, lined with cafés, kebab shops, corner shops and hardware stores rather than shiny chains. Caledonian Road tube on the Piccadilly line and Caledonian Road & Barnsbury on the Overground both serve it, so getting here without a car is no trouble at all, which is just as well, because parking round here is a nightmare.

It's an over-18s venue, so leave the kids at home. If you're making a day of it, head down to King's Cross for Granary Square and Coal Drops Yard, or take the canal towpath along Regent's Canal for a quieter wander.
